description_en: Verifies the three-element identity of a phone number (detailed version - standard edition)
description_zh: 手机号三要素详版_标准版
name: Mobile3MetaDetailStandardVerify

parameters.help_en:
The parameter type. Valid values:

normal: not encrypted.
md5: MD5-encrypted
parameters.help_zh:
参数类型：

normal：不加密。
md5：md5加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID card number.

If ParamType is set to normal, pass in the ID card number in plaintext.
If ParamType is set to md5, pass in the MD5-encrypted ID card number
parameters.help_zh:
身份证号：

paramType 传 normal 时：传入身份证号明文。
paramType 传 md5 时：传入身份证号密文
parameters.name: identify_num

parameters.help_en:
The name.

If ParamType is set to normal, pass in the name in plaintext.
If ParamType is set to md5, pass in the MD5-encrypted name
parameters.help_zh:
姓名：

paramType 传 normal 时：传入姓名明文。
paramType 传 md5 时：传入姓名密文
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The phone number.

If ParamType is set to normal, pass in the phone number in plaintext.
If ParamType is set to md5, pass in the MD5-encrypted phone number
parameters.help_zh:
手机号：

paramType 传 normal 时：传入手机号明文。
paramType 传 md5 时：传入手机号密文
parameters.name: mobile

Code.description_en: The return code. 200 indicates a successful response
Code.description_zh: 返回码，200表示接口响应成功

BizCode.description_en:
The verification result code. Valid values:
1: Verification is consistent.
2: Verification is inconsistent.
3: No record found
BizCode.description_zh:
核验结果码：
1：核验一致。
2：核验不一致。
3：查无记录

IspName.description_en:
The carrier name. Valid values:

CMCC: China Mobile.
CUCC: China Unicom.
CTCC: China Telecom.
CBCC: China Broadnet
IspName.description_zh:
运营商名称：

CMCC：移动。
CUCC：联通。
CTCC：电信。
CBCC：广电

SubCode.description_en:
The detailed verification result. Valid values:

101: Verification passed. All three elements are consistent.
201: The phone number is inconsistent with both the name and the ID card number.
202: The phone number is consistent with the name but inconsistent with the ID card number.
203: The phone number is inconsistent with the name but consistent with the ID card number.
204: Other inconsistency.
301: No record found
SubCode.description_zh:
核验详细结果：

101：验证通过 ，三要素校验一致。
201：手机号与姓名、证件号对比均不一致。
202：手机号与姓名一致，但与证件号不一致。
203：手机号与姓名不一致，但与证件号一致。
204：其他不一致。
301：查无记录
